verdict.rationale: dLocal's own docs list "Mass payouts" as a capability, which is a first-party bulk operation (disbursing to many recipients at once), but the evidence is a single feature-list line with no detail on how batches are submitted or processed. Nothing shows bulk actions on other items such as payments, refunds or enrollments. Missing for 10: documentation of a bulk/batch API or file-upload mechanism, bulk operations beyond payouts (e.g. bulk refunds, cancellations or status updates), limits and error handling for batches, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Mass payouts, multi-currency support, and compliance with local regulations.
